name: The Palantír of Orthanc
game_text:
To play, spot an <culture>Isengard</culture> minion. Plays to your support area.
<phase>Shadow</phase>: Spot an <culture>Isengard</culture> minion and remove <twilight>1</twilight> to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player’s hand. Place that card on top of that player’s draw deck.
